name: tahti-timetable
description: TAHTI - accessible timetable for Turku UAS students

scripts.format: prettier --write package.json apps/frontend/package.json apps/backend/package.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md UPSTREAM.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json apps/frontend/package.json apps/backend/package.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md UPSTREAM.md
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apps/frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/backend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run standards && npm run build
